memory_update.text: LW is the direct reference public asset for QSR frozen potato products; use it as the comparison anchor for customer stickiness, capacity, crop-cost, pricing, and ERP-disruption diligence.

MZTI is an underfollowed adjacent signature-side supplier with explicit national-chain and Chick-fil-A concentration; not potato-specific, but potentially relevant to high-margin restaurant side/sauce dependency mapping.
JBTM maps to the equipment/software layer behind frozen-food and value-added side processing; direct frozen-potato customer exposure remains a verification gap.
COLD maps to the cold-chain infrastructure layer required for frozen potato and frozen-side distribution; direct QSR/frozen-potato customer exposure remains unverified.

Most major frozen-potato competitors and QSR fry suppliers, including McCain and J.R. Simplot, appear private; US-listed exposure is therefore concentrated in LW plus adjacent infrastructure/equipment/signature-side suppliers.

node: Frozen potato products and high-margin signature sides for QSR chains
summary: Expanded the universe around the frozen-potato/signature-side chokepoint using a two-lane funnel. Lamb Weston is the direct reference asset for frozen potato QSR exposure. The underfollowed lane adds Marzetti as a signature-side and custom-formulated restaurant supplier with disclosed Chick-fil-A dependency, JBT Marel as a food-processing/freezing/frying equipment and software supplier to processors, and Americold as a cold-chain infrastructure beneficiary tied to frozen/perishable food movement. These are research candidates only, not buy/sell recommendations.
